title: The start gate becomes the welcome: the A6 settlement pocket guide over the landing, keywords that turn their unit in wireframe, START A NEW PLANET as the call to action, and Isao's WELCOME! / Let's settle a new planet together! / Ad Astra Per Aspera
context: Owner, 2026-10-05: use the settlement guide (jelaludo.github.io/SentryTowers_A6/settlement-guide/) as the first landing page; hovering keywords such as SH02, ISAO or STALHEART brings up little modals of their animated wireframe units; Start a new Planet bigger, a call to action; new voices made with seiyu_voice: WELCOME!, Let's settle a new planet together!, and Ad Astra Per Aspera once the player clicks Start.
outcome: src/fx/start-gate.js keeps its contract (createStartGate, opened, dispose, open without a page) and now draws the guide: its copy, paper and ink (styles scoped to #start-gate), its six wireframe drawings copied to assets/welcome/, the stamps. SH02, ISAO, Stålheart, MÖRK, KORP, SOL and ARC-01 are keyword buttons: hover, focus or tap shows a small dark card turning that unit's game model as a wireframe (src/fx/wireframe-stage.js, one context at a time, disposed on hide). START A NEW PLANET is a large orange breathing pill, sticky at the bottom. The arrival shows the guide from the first frame of a landing (no longer only when the sound is off) and holds; its load clock starts on START. Isao says welcome then welcome_settle as soon as the sound can start (at once, or on the first gesture that is not START), ad_astra on START; the landing begins as that line ends, and isaoFree clears the voice's spacing so the mission line still plays. seiyu_voice: triggers welcome, welcome_settle, ad_astra in section 1 (exported unapproved).
alternatives: Linking to the guide page or embedding it in an iframe: a second page between the player and the game, and its links lead out to the workshop
One image per keyword (the guide's SVGs): not animated; the game's own models are already loaded by the wireframe stage the briefings use
evidence: --opening: the guide shows with START; a click elsewhere does not land, and Isao says welcome_01 then welcome_settle_01; hovering Stålheart shows its wireframe card (screenshot); START says ad_astra_01, then the landing with mission_05, rough_landing_01, so_much_to_build_01
--opening-cuts and --grow pass; unit tests (voice events accept isaoSay from the guide), npm run check and the architecture guard pass
